settings.endpointDescription: When an existing rclone RC address is provided (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5572), Ourboros connects to it instead of starting its own rclone rcd. Leave empty to start a managed rclone rcd. rclone is not started automatically by default.
settings.rcUrlPlaceholder: http://127.0.0.1:5572, leave empty for managed rcd
settings.autoStart: Automatically connect to / start rclone when Ourboros starts
settings.autoStartHint: Off by default: rclone only starts when you click "Start / connect".
settings.binaryDescription: Current source {{source}}. When empty, rclone from the system PATH is used.
settings.shortcutsDescription: Active while an Ourboros window is focused. Use a format like CmdOrCtrl+Shift+O. Leave blank to restore the default.
settings.shortcutsHint: Shortcuts only work while an Ourboros window is focused, not in other apps.
settings.cliDescription: Values that come from the current process command line cannot be changed on this page.
